title: Tech Note: Drag and Drop in 4D View

historical_commentary.text: 4D View has been discontinued, making the specific drag-and-drop commands described here obsolete for current development; drag-and-drop functionality in modern 4D applications is now typically implemented via list box form objects or, for web-based UIs, standard HTML5 drag-and-drop APIs.
related_updates: 4D View has been discontinued; list box form objects or HTML5 drag-and-drop APIs (in web areas) are the modern equivalents
